pair.title: Connect your Atmoce gateway
pair.intro: Homey talks to the gateway directly over your home network. Turn on Modbus-TCP in the Atmozen app under Settings → 3rd Party System; that screen also shows the IP address.
pair.searching: Searching your network for Atmoce gateways…
pair.none_found: No Atmoce gateway found automatically. Check that Modbus-TCP is on in Atmozen, or enter the IP address below. The MC100L Lite has no local connection and cannot be added.

errors.cannot_reach: No Atmoce gateway answers at __host__. Check the IP address and that Modbus-TCP is on in Atmozen
errors.other_gateway: This address belongs to another Atmoce gateway (__serial__). Pair that gateway as a new device instead
errors.needs_firmware: This needs gateway firmware __needed__ or newer (this gateway has __current__). Atmoce installs updates through its cloud; ask your installer or Atmoce support.
errors.not_connected: Not connected to the gateway yet
errors.host_required: Enter the IP address of the gateway
errors.invalid_unit_id: Enter a unit ID between 1 and 247
errors.no_battery: This gateway reports no battery. Add the solar panels or grid meter instead
errors.charge_limit: The batteries can charge at most __max__ W
errors.discharge_limit: The batteries can discharge at most __max__ W
errors.test_failed: The gateway at __host__ did not answer: __error__

warning.system_fault: The Atmoce system reports a fault. Open the Atmozen app for details.
warning.battery_faulty: A battery reports an alarm and is neither charging nor discharging. Open the Atmozen app for details.
warning.battery_shutdown: All batteries are shut down. Open the Atmozen app for details.

notify.system_fault: **__device__**: the Atmoce system reports a fault (power station status 60066 = 1). Open the Atmozen app for the alarm details. __context__
notify.battery_faulty: **__device__**: at least one battery has an active alarm and the batteries stopped charging and discharging (running status 60098 = 4). Open the Atmozen app for the alarm details. __context__
notify.battery_shutdown: **__device__**: all batteries have shut down (running status 60098 = 3). Open the Atmozen app for details. __context__
notify.battery_problem_cleared: **__device__**: the batteries are working normally again.
notify.grid_outage: **__device__**: power cut. The grid is down and the system is running off-grid (60096 = 1). __context__
notify.grid_restored: **__device__**: the grid is back and the system is connected to it again.
notify.connection_lost: **Atmoce gateway __serial__** has not answered for __duration__ at __host__ (__error__). Homey keeps trying and searches the network in case the address changed.
notify.firmware_updated: **Atmoce gateway __serial__** was updated from firmware __previous__ to __current__.
notify.test_ok: **__device__**: connection test OK. __host__ (unit __unit__) answered in __ms__ ms. Gateway __serial__, firmware __firmware__. Optional registers: __registers__. Readings since app start: __polls__, failed: __failed__.
